d:
Jharkhand ke charchit nisha bhagat mamle men jyotsana kerketta ne pahli bar apne oopar lage aaropon ko lekar khulkar apni bat rakhi. midiya ke samne aaeen jyotsana kerketta ne pure mamle par apni saphaee di aur kaee aham savalon ke javab die.
Aakhir nisha bhagat mamle men jyotsana kerketta ne kya kaha? apne oopar lage aaropon par unhonne kya saphaee di? dekhie yah khas riporta.
